content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IIT Roorkee Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is being conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Roorkee (IIT Roorkee) for project-based research positions under the Department of Civil Engineering.

faq.question: Q2. What is the name of the post advertised by IIT Roorkee?
faq.answer: The post advertised is Project Assistant (Technical) with a total of 1 vacancy available for eligible candidates having suitable engineering qualifications.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M.Tech. degree in Structural Engineering along with 02 years of relevant professional or research experience to apply for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant (Technical) position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Project Assistant (Technical) role will receive a monthly salary ranging between Rs. 26,000 and Rs. 30,000.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application and selection for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application and selection mode is purely via a Walk-in Interview. Candidates can submit their applications in advance via email or bring them directly to the interview venue.

faq.question: Q6. What is the date for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 14 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they report to the venue on time along with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q7. Where will the walk-in interview take place?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be conducted at Room No. 337, Department of Civil Engineering, IIT Roorkee, Roorkee, starting at 12:00 PM.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply for this job?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making the application process free of charge for all interested candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Can applications be sent via email before the interview?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates can submit their applications along with their CV, Degree Certificates, and Experience Certificates through email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. What documents should I bring to the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring their updated CV, original educational degree certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and self-attested photocopies along with passport-size photographs.
